items.title: DEAD DECK IS COMING TO GOOGLE PLAY  -  1 DECEMBER
items.body:
Dead Deck is coming to Google Play on 1 December.

The full game: 60+ death games, party matches, ranked, the Dead Deck Pass, and a story mode with playable chases, shootouts, stealth and fights.

Tell your friends, grab your seat at the table, and be ready when the deck opens.

Good luck. Don't die.

items.title: WELCOME TO THE DEAD DECK BETA
items.body:
You made it in. Thank you for being one of the first players in Dead Deck.

This is an early build: over 60 death games, the multiplayer party matches, the Dead Deck Pass, missions and the store are all live. Some things will break, and some games will be too easy or far too deadly. That's what the beta is for.

STORY MODE will not be available until the final release. We're finishing every chapter so it's worth the wait.

Play with friends, try every suit, and tell us what you think. New games and fixes are coming throughout the beta. Watch this NEWS tab for updates.

Good luck. Don't die.
